name: David Johnston
story: David Johnston co-authored the 2015 retrospective explaining the Auckland lifelines project begun in 1996.
Michele Daly and David Johnston’s later account describes hazard and infrastructure maps alongside workshops in which utilities assessed vulnerability and recovery.
LINZ’s Brown Bag Resilience Series names David Johnston: Massey University / QuakeCoRE; natural hazard readiness, 11 April 2019.
